defaultLocale.description: BCP 47 language tag the host falls back to when no `Accept-Language` matches `supportedLocales`. Default: `"en"` when omitted.

supportedLocales.description: BCP 47 tags of locales the host has validated end-to-end for human-facing text. MUST contain `defaultLocale` when both are present.
